objective: Proof: no native gadget of any knot has the support of an equality on three or more legs; windable gadgets have hub ratio at most the square root of 3 on every axis (given McQuillan); parity and Fibonacci gadgets have hub ratio at most 1; for every gadget, diagonal pairs whose difference does not link all three terminals map injectively onto off-diagonal pairs (exchange lemma); the eight non-windable knots are a closed neighbourhood plus its antipode, so for the six open knots only pairs linked through a knot that is empty on one side and full on the other can raise the ratio.
status: Proved by SOFT-HUB-20261024-001A-P001: no native gadget of any knot is an exact hub (co-independent supports); exchanging whole difference components bounds every pair that does not link all three terminals by the split products, and linked pairs branch at antipodal local tuples; parity and no-lone gadgets have hub ratio at most 1 and windable gadgets at most the square root of 3 (given McQuillan); the eight non-windable knots are closed neighbourhoods plus antipodes, rigid for exchanges, so only the six open knots' linked pairs remain open.
title: Hub ratios of the settled knots
